title: External conditions on the trend switch: variance ratio VR(5,63) and the VIX term structure
reference_switch: trend λ5 rolling 1260 (incumbent); if momentum_cycle_timing promotes another switch the test is re-run against it and both runs are kept

conditions.VR own: Lo-MacKinlay VR(5,63) on the fund's own log returns exactly as the screener defines it: Var(5-day log return)/(5 x Var(1-day)), both over a trailing 63-bar window, then a 200-bar simple MA (~267-bar warm-up); condition = VR_MA >= 1 (trend-friendly). No tuning: the neutral value 1 is the threshold.
conditions.VR SPY: the same statistic on SPY, broadcast to every fund (market-level trendiness)
conditions.VIX term: VIX3M - VIX (CBOE, via FMP; VIX3M from 2006-07) >= 0 (contango = not stressed); inversion (< 0) switches off. No tuning.
conditions.VIX9D not used: starts 2011; too short for the folds

alignment: every condition is evaluated at close T-1 and gates day T; SPY/VIX series aligned to each fund's calendar by causal forward-fill
execution_and_folds: identical to frozen_rule_benchmark; VIX arms' OOS starts at the later of the trend warm-up and 2006-07 + 1 day

decision_rule.PROMOTE_condition: vs the reference switch: median ΔMartin > 0 with CI excluding 0, OR wins >= 6/8 with median ΔSharpe >= 0; AND bull-fold bleed not worse than the reference by > 0.10 in any bull fold
decision_rule.note: a condition can only remove exposure, so it must earn its keep in the bear folds without bleeding in the bull folds; MaxDD is reported with the 50% participation floor, not gated

prior: VR: about 1 in 5 (267-bar warm-up makes it very slow; it is an IBS precondition, not a timing signal); VIX term: about 1 in 4 (program's monthly VIX tests found variance content, zero mean content; a daily switch condition is a different claim)
